title: Better search UX
author: bernaferrari
lessons: Track positions during matching, not after — backtracking algorithms need inline position recording
Group consecutive characters for rendering — reduces DOM node count
Clone-on-write for pipeline data — spread operator avoids mutation
Subjective PRs can still be objectively good — standard UX patterns are standard for a reason
